translation: When summer heat blocks the qi so there is no sweat, and thirst leads to drinking water that stagnates, Xiangru must be assisted by Xingren, because Xingren descends by its bitterness and drains the qi; this is the principle behind Da Shun San.

Long summer is the season of dampness, so summerheat must combine with dampness. Summerheat injures the qi aspect, and dampness also injures the qi. Sweating consumes the qi and injures the yang, and the stomach fluids are greatly robbed and scorched, so transformed diseases arise from this in great number. When the season of effusion and discharge governs, the true qi within naturally becomes deficient.
Zhang Fengkui said, "In summerheat disease, first use acrid-cool, then sweet-cold, then sour-draining and sour-astringent, and there is no need to use purgation."
